items.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Fuel can leak where the fuel pipe meets the fuel rail (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: High-pressure fuel tube can leak (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rearview camera can shut off in reverse (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at the dealer
items.note: Free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Scraping noise and stalling from torque converter damage
items.job: Replace torque converter
items.note: Should be covered by the powertrain warranty on these model years.

items.t: Check engine light from a transmission solenoid or control module
items.job: Replace shift solenoid or transmission E-module

items.t: Misfire and check engine light on the 2.5 turbo
items.job: Diagnose misfire; replace spark plugs or ignition coil as needed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $417-$525 for GV80 spark plugs.

items.t: Oil leak at the turbo oil feed pipe
items.job: Polish turbo oil feed pipe sealing surfaces and replace gaskets

items.t: Oil level warning without a real oil problem
items.job: Engine computer update or oil level sensor check

items.t: AWD or limited-slip differential warning codes
items.job: Diagnose and replace E-LSD or transfer case actuator

items.t: Hum or whine from the rear differential
items.job: Inspect and retighten rear differential lock nut

items.t: AWD always on from the wrong control module
items.job: Install correct AWD control unit

items.t: Water leak from clogged sunroof drains
items.job: Replace sunroof drain hose plugs and clear drains
items.note: Wet carpet or water-damaged electronics cost extra.

items.t: Headlight fills with moisture and stops working
items.job: Replace headlight assembly
items.note: Owners report $2,000-$3,000 dealer quotes out of warranty.

items.t: Horn stops working
items.job: Replace horns and remount upright

items.t: Power tailgate won't close or latch properly
items.job: Power tailgate module software update

items.t: Rattle from the tailgate or rear side panel
items.job: Add washers to side guide bumpers

items.t: Rubbing noise when turning the steering wheel
items.job: Inspect clock spring; replace multifunction switch assembly

items.t: Steering shudder and driver-assist shutting off
items.job: Steering and driver-assist diagnosis and calibration
items.note: Parts extra if a steering component has failed.

items.t: Genesis Connected Services stop working
items.job: Connected services reset or software update

items.t: Battery drains while parked
items.job: Control panel fix per bulletin; battery test
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $470-$499 for a GV80 battery if it needs replacing.

items.t: Infotainment screen goes black or restarts
items.job: Infotainment software update or reset

items.t: Door won't unlock with the handle touch sensor
items.job: Seal door handle touch sensors

items.t: Loose windshield trim seal
items.job: Replace windshield garnish and seal

items.t: Driver attention warning goes off for no reason
items.job: Driver-assist software check and camera inspection

items.t: Keyless entry and fingerprint reader stop responding
items.job: Smart key system diagnosis

items.t: Paint peeling
items.job: Refinish affected panel
